import requests, numpy as np, json
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
UA={"User-Agent":"Mozilla/5.0"}
t2o=dict(zip("ALA ARG ASN ASP CYS GLN GLU GLY HIS ILE LEU LYS MET PHE PRO SER THR TRP TYR VAL MSE".split(),"ARNDCQEGHILKMFPSTWYVM"))
def fetch(p): return requests.get(f"https://files.rcsb.org/download/{p}.pdb",timeout=180,headers=UA).text.split("\n")
def atoms(lines,chain=None,het=None):
    o=[]
    for l in lines:
        if not l.startswith(("ATOM  ","HETATM")) or l[76:78].strip()=="H" or l[16] not in(" ","A"): continue
        rn=l[17:20].strip(); ch=l[21]; ri=int(l[22:26]); an=l[12:16].strip()
        x=np.array([float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])])
        if het is not None:
            if l.startswith("HETATM") and rn in het: o.append((rn,ch,ri,an,x))
        elif ch==chain and rn in t2o: o.append((rn,ch,ri,an,x))
    return o
L1=fetch("1CQI"); L2=fetch("3DMY")
A1=atoms(L1,"A"); A2=atoms(L2,"A"); HET=atoms(L1,het={"COA","PO4"})
ca1={ri:x for rn,ch,ri,an,x in A1 if an=="CA"}; ca2={ri:x for rn,ch,ri,an,x in A2 if an=="CA"}
aa2={ri:t2o[rn] for rn,ch,ri,an,x in A2}
exec(open("/dev/null").read()) if False else None
ANCH_549=[[a,b] for a,b in zip(range(150,272),[336,337,338,339,340,341,342,343,344,345,346,347,348,349,350,351,352,353,369,370,371,372,373,374,375,376,377,378,379,380,381,382,383,384,394,395,396,397,398,399,400,401,402,403,404,405,406,407,408,409,410,411,412,413,414,415,416,417,418,419,420,422,423,424,425,426,427,428,429,430,431,432,433,434,435,436,437,438,449,450,451,452,453,454,455,456,457,458,459,460,461,462,463,464,465,466,467,468,469,470,471,472,473,474,475,476,477,478,479,480,481,482,483,484,485,486,487,488,489,490,491,492])]
ANCH_629=[[5,191],[6,192],[7,193],[8,194],[9,195],[10,196],[11,197],[12,198],[13,199],[14,200],[15,201],[16,202],[17,203],[18,204],[19,207],[20,208],[21,209],[22,210],[23,211],[24,212],[25,213],[26,214],[27,215],[28,216],[29,217],[30,218],[31,219],[32,220],[33,221],[34,222],[35,223],[36,224],[37,225],[38,226],[39,227],[40,228],[41,229],[42,230],[43,231],[44,232],[45,233],[46,234],[47,235],[48,236],[49,237],[50,238],[51,239],[52,240],[53,241],[54,242],[55,243],[56,244],[57,245],[58,246],[59,247],[60,248],[61,249],[62,250],[65,251],[66,252],[67,253],[68,254],[69,255],[70,256],[71,257],[72,258],[73,263],[74,264],[75,265],[76,266],[77,267],[78,268],[79,269],[80,270],[81,271],[82,272],[83,273],[84,274],[85,275],[86,276],[87,277],[88,278],[89,279],[90,280],[91,281],[92,282],[93,283],[94,284],[95,285],[96,286],[97,287],[98,288]]
def kabsch(P,Q):
    pc=P.mean(0); qc=Q.mean(0); V,S,Wt=np.linalg.svd((P-pc).T@(Q-qc))
    return V@np.diag([1,1,np.sign(np.linalg.det(V@Wt))])@Wt, qc-pc@(V@np.diag([1,1,np.sign(np.linalg.det(V@Wt))])@Wt)
def fit(anch):
    pr=[(a,b) for a,b in anch if a in ca1 and b in ca2]
    P=np.array([ca1[a] for a,b in pr]); Q=np.array([ca2[b] for a,b in pr]); R,t=kabsch(P,Q)
    for _ in range(6):
        d=np.linalg.norm(P@R+t-Q,axis=1); keep=d<max(4.0,np.percentile(d,70))
        if keep.sum()<20: break
        R,t=kabsch(P[keep],Q[keep])
    d=np.linalg.norm(P@R+t-Q,axis=1); return R,t,pr,d
R5,t5,pr5,d5=fit(ANCH_549); R6,t6,pr6,d6=fit(ANCH_629)
COA=np.array([x for rn,ch,ri,an,x in HET if rn=="COA" and ch=="A"])
PO4=np.array([x for rn,ch,ri,an,x in HET if rn=="PO4" and ch=="A"])
P2=np.array([x for rn,ch,ri,an,x in A2])
def mind(L,R,t):
    Lt=L@R+t; return np.array([np.linalg.norm(P2-p,axis=1).min() for p in Lt]), Lt
dc,_=mind(COA,R6,t6); dp,PO4t=mind(PO4,R5,t5)
print("CoA transplant: %d/%d atoms clash (<2.2 A) with AllF, median nearest-atom distance %.2f A"%((dc<2.2).sum(),len(dc),np.median(dc)))
print("PO4 transplant: %d/%d atoms clash (<2.2 A), median nearest-atom distance %.2f A"%((dp<2.2).sum(),len(dp),np.median(dp)))
# control: transplant CoA into the SucD frame itself (should be clash free)
P1=np.array([x for rn,ch,ri,an,x in A1])
dc0=np.array([np.linalg.norm(P1-p,axis=1).min() for p in COA])
dp0=np.array([np.linalg.norm(P1-p,axis=1).min() for p in PO4])
print("CONTROL in native SucD: CoA clashes=%d (median %.2f A); PO4 clashes=%d (median %.2f A)"%((dc0<2.2).sum(),np.median(dc0),(dp0<2.2).sum(),np.median(dp0)))
h246=[x for rn,ch,ri,an,x in A1 if ch=="A" and ri==246 and an=="NE2"][0]@R5+t5
h389=[x for rn,ch,ri,an,x in A2 if ri==389 and an=="NE2"][0]
print("AllF His389 NE2 to SucD-His246 NE2 position: %.1f A ; to transplanted PO4 P atom: %.1f A"%(
    np.linalg.norm(h389-h246), np.linalg.norm(h389-PO4t[0])))
print("anchor fit quality: PF00549 core RMSD %.2f A over %d CA ; PF02629 core RMSD %.2f A over %d CA"%(
    np.sqrt((d5[d5<4]**2).mean()),(d5<4).sum(),np.sqrt((d6[d6<4]**2).mean()),(d6<4).sum()))

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(15,4.6))
ax=axes[0]
bins=np.arange(0,9.1,0.5)
ax.hist(dc0,bins=bins,color="#2d6a4f",alpha=0.75,label="CoA in native SucD (1CQI)")
ax.hist(dc,bins=bins,color="#e07a5f",alpha=0.75,label="CoA transplanted into AllF (3DMY)")
ax.axvline(2.2,ls="--",c="k",lw=1); ax.text(2.3,ax.get_ylim()[1]*0.9,"clash\nthreshold",fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlabel("distance to nearest protein heavy atom (A)"); ax.set_ylabel("CoA atoms")
ax.set_title("A  CoA pocket of SucD is occluded in AllF",fontsize=10); ax.legend(fontsize=8)
ax=axes[1]
ax.hist(dp0,bins=bins,color="#2d6a4f",alpha=0.75,label="PO4 in native SucD")
ax.hist(dp,bins=bins,color="#4a7bb7",alpha=0.75,label="PO4 transplanted into AllF")
ax.axvline(2.2,ls="--",c="k",lw=1)
ax.set_xlabel("distance to nearest protein heavy atom (A)"); ax.set_ylabel("phosphate atoms")
ax.set_title("B  Power-helix anion site is open in AllF",fontsize=10); ax.legend(fontsize=8)
ax=axes[2]
labs=["SucD H247 equiv.\nin AllF = Q467","AllF H389 NE2\nto SucD H247 NE2","AllF H389 NE2\nto transplanted P","AllF T341 OG1\nto transplanted P"]
t341=[x for rn,ch,ri,an,x in A2 if ri==341 and an=="OG1"][0]
vals=[0,float(np.linalg.norm(h389-h246)),float(np.linalg.norm(h389-PO4t[0])),float(np.linalg.norm(t341-PO4t[0]))]
cols=["#8d99ae","#e07a5f","#e07a5f","#4a7bb7"]
b=ax.bar(range(4),vals,color=cols)
ax.set_xticks(range(4)); ax.set_xticklabels(labs,fontsize=7.5)
ax.set_ylabel("distance (A)"); ax.set_title("C  Geometry after HMM-anchored superposition\n(core RMSD 2.2 A)",fontsize=10)
for i,v in enumerate(vals):
    ax.text(i,v+0.15,"substituted" if v==0 else "%.1f"%v,ha="center",fontsize=9)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
